issues: The 316 matrix items are normalized interpretations of original source terms, not separate empirical observations, direct quotations or a full diplomatic transcription.

The 1647 author groups planet-associated persons and occupations using era-specific class, religion, gender, criminality and morality stereotypes. Those are not legitimate classifications of any living person.

The seven planetary person/matter cells and the separate six sign-related planetary-nature classes are different tables. Do not merge or mistake absence of a lunar sign-nature row for omitted lunar person/matter entries.
Exact sign and house calculations, zodiac elements, partile aspect thresholds and planet dignities must be frozen with astronomy and 17th-century calendar assumptions before any future human test.
Planet, sign, house and partile aspect are different dimensions of the source method, not four independently corroborating observational studies.

The source explicitly acknowledges rare all-favorable natal testimonies, frequent mixtures, losses despite strong general wealth configurations and gains despite strong unfavorable configurations; no ad hoc rescues allowed in prospective tests.
The example of the third house assigning potential loss to a brother/kinsman is not independently observed and cannot justify a claim about a person's relatives.
The author refers to the condition in which ancestors left a person as a baseline; real tests must compare against socioeconomic origins and mobility without astrology.
Period age, birthplace, social hierarchy, vocation, gender, trade and access to property are confounders. They must not be treated as astrological causal results.
The time-varying source claims have no quantitative event-date precision, net-worth thresholds, or outcome windows and cannot be used for actual investment decisions.
Some historical spelling and printed glyphs remain subject to independent specialist transcription; all item lists carry normalized-not-diplomatic flags.
Following printed CHAP CXVI starts on original PDF594. It concerns lawful or unlawful means of wealth, and its substantive clauses are not included as if they belonged to printed CXV.
Source-first claim and matrix preservation does not create an executable validated astrological model or make 316 correct predictions.
